
===== scenario: A-tun-bypass-client-only (start) =====
uci -q show dhcp.@dnsmasq[0]
config_load homeproxy
sing-box version -n
uname -r
ip route show default
ip -6 route show default
ifstatus wan
ucode -S etc/homeproxy/scripts/generate_client.uc
init.d/dnsmasq restart
ip link show singtun0
ip link set singtun0 up
ip route replace default dev singtun0 table 100
ip rule del fwmark 102 table 100
ip rule add fwmark 102 table 100
procd_open_instance sing-box-c
procd_set_param command /usr/bin/sing-box
procd_append_param command run --config var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.json
procd_add_jail sing-box-c log procfs
procd_add_jail_mount var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.json
procd_add_jail_mount_rw var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.log
procd_add_jail_mount etc/homeproxy/
procd_add_jail_mount_rw etc/homeproxy/cache.db
procd_add_jail_mount etc/homeproxy/certs/
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/acme/
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/ssl/
procd_add_jail_mount /tmp/dhcp.leases
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/localtime
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/TZ
procd_set_param capabilities /etc/capabilities/homeproxy.json
procd_set_param no_new_privs 1
procd_set_param user sing-box
procd_set_param group sing-box
procd_set_param limits core=unlimited
procd_set_param limits nofile=1000000 1000000
procd_set_param stderr 1
procd_set_param respawn
procd_close_instance
procd_open_instance log-cleaner
procd_set_param command etc/homeproxy/scripts/clean_log.sh
procd_set_param respawn
procd_close_instance
chown sing-box:sing-box var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.json
chown sing-box:sing-box var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.log
chown sing-box:sing-box etc/homeproxy/cache.db
ucode etc/homeproxy/scripts/firewall_pre.uc
utpl -S etc/homeproxy/scripts/firewall_post.ut
fw4 reload
init.d/miniupnpd enabled
init.d/miniupnpd running
init.d/miniupnpd restart
config_load homeproxy
jsonfilter -e @['homeproxy'].instances['sing-box-c']
jsonfilter -e @.running
jsonfilter -e @.exit_code
netstat -ltnup
sleep 1
jsonfilter -e @['homeproxy'].instances['sing-box-c']
jsonfilter -e @.running
jsonfilter -e @.exit_code
netstat -ltnup
sleep 1
jsonfilter -e @['homeproxy'].instances['sing-box-c']
jsonfilter -e @.running
jsonfilter -e @.exit_code
netstat -ltnup
nslookup -port=5333 example.com 127.0.0.1
nc 127.0.0.1 5330
chmod 600 var/run/homeproxy/known-good/sing-box-c.json
config_load homeproxy
sing-box version -n
log sing-box 1.14.0 started.
start rc=0
chmod 600 etc/crontabs/root
init.d/cron restart
config_load homeproxy

ip route del local 0.0.0.0/0 dev lo table 100
ip -6 rule del fwmark 101 table 100
ip -6 route del local ::/0 dev lo table 100

===== scenario: D-health-gate-rollback (reload) =====
